The house

Welcome to The House of Dreams

Whether you're flying in for a getaway, visiting family, or exploring El Salvador, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home with a front yard puts you close to everything. The airport is 18 minutes away, the beach is 38, and some of the best pupusas in the country are 8 minutes down the road. Come back to a comfortable place to relax, cook, and recharge.
